body:
Build brief. Game rules approved by Karolis 30-31 Oct.
PET SHOW WITH FRIENDS (rules-pet-show-friends): Saturdays 8:00-20:00 in the park. Someone enters: friends in the park get 45 seconds to join. Friends' pets take NPC places (4 per show); more than 4: next show right after. Everyone watches the same show. Judges: style, tricks, happiness; healthy-week ribbon helps. NPC scores from the shared clock, no dice. Sick pets can't enter. One pet per player per show; one show per player per Saturday.
HEALTHY WEEK (rules-mech-ribbon): per player, no pet sick + care on 3+ days Mon-Fri -> all your pets wear the ribbon.
ANIMAL LICENSE (rules-animal-license): level 1 = 1 win + 1 healthy week, level 2 = 2 + 2, level 3 = 3 wins (one 1st place) + 3 healthy weeks. Top 3 counts as a win only for the license; prizes and the 'Win the Pet Show' quest stay 1st place. Counted from the update, never taken away. Sir Barkley hands it over on the podium; license card in My pets. Unlocks big pets (stage 4).
MOVES: moves-show-license (Sir Barkley on the podium; Pet Show tricks exist already).
SCREENS: screens-show-join (45 s join card + waiting list), screens-license-card (vintage paper card; needs Google fonts Alfa Slab One + Roboto Slab 700/800; the test kit must serve them locally).
TRICKS (rules-tricks, approved 31 Oct): each pet type has 3 tricks and starts knowing 1; 5 practice days on its training gear (one counts per game day) teach the next; only known tricks at the show, practised ones get a bigger gold zone; sick pets can't practise. Old saves: every pet knows its first trick.
WAITING FOR KAROLIS: Pet Show podium + small 3D license card models (objects-petshow-podium); Moves uses marked stand-ins until they exist. Trick moves: 3 per pet type (14 types), Moves drafting.
TRICKS (approved 31 Oct): 3 per pet type, the 4 dogs share one set (moves-show-tricks A); COZY_MOVES.TRICKS + play(m,'trick',...) replace psTrickAnim and today's 3 random of 6 (js/07-designer.js TRICKS); tricks last 5 s. PET SHOW AREA: placed in Cozy Park (map-petshow-park); slide moved 1.8 m W / 2 m back; food truck turned along the south park fence (townCodeChanges in claude/pfu-placements.json). Podium + hand-held license card: plan approved (A), models by Objects.

comments.text: What changed: next show if over 4; wins earn the license.
